statement_map.email_excerpt: Your custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on your own domain.
Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record for "shop" with the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings, and your domain loaded.
You then replaced the second "www" record with a CNAME record for "www" using the same target value, and you confirmed both versions now load your funnel.
We explained that your old A record for "shop", pointing to an old server address, was blocking the connection.
We explained that the www version still showed an error because a second record for "www" pointed somewhere else.
The padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
We will check that your secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not. We said we would do this tomorrow morning.
